description: A food company would like to run its commercials on three streaming platforms: Pi TV, Beta Video and Gamma Live. The cost for a commercial as well as the expected audience reach is given. On Pi TV, a commercial costs $1200 and attracts 2000 viewers. On Beta Video, a commercial costs $2000 and attracts 5000 viewers. On Gamma Live, a commercial costs $4000 and attracts 9000 viewers. Beta Video limits the number of commercials from a single company to 8. In order to attract a wide range of people, at most a third of all commercials should occur on Gamma Live and a minimum of 20% should occur on Pi TV. If the weekly budget is $20000, how many commercials should be run in each of the three possible choices in order to maximize audience?

CostPiTV.definition: Cost per commercial on Pi TV

CostBetaVideo.definition: Cost per commercial on Beta Video

CostGammaLive.definition: Cost per commercial on Gamma Live

AudiencePiTV.definition: Audience per commercial on Pi TV

AudienceBetaVideo.definition: Audience per commercial on Beta Video

AudienceGammaLive.definition: Audience per commercial on Gamma Live

MaxCommercialsBetaVideo.definition: Maximum number of commercials on Beta Video

MaxGammaProportion.definition: Maximum proportion of all commercials on Gamma Live

MinPiTVProportion.definition: Minimum proportion of all commercials on Pi TV

objective.description: "Maximize the total expected audience reach from commercials across Pi TV, Beta Video, and Gamma Live"
objective.formulation: $\max \left( AudiencePiTV \cdot NumPiTV \;+\; AudienceBetaVideo \cdot NumBetaVideo \;+\; AudienceGammaLive \cdot NumGammaLive \right)$

constraints.description: Total cost of commercials on Pi TV, Beta Video, and Gamma Live should not exceed the total weekly budget
constraints.formulation: $CostPiTV \\cdot NumPiTV + CostBetaVideo \\cdot NumBetaVideo + CostGammaLive \\cdot NumGammaLive \\leq TotalBudget$

constraints.description: Number of commercials on Beta Video should not exceed the maximum allowed on Beta Video
Number of commercials on Gamma Live should be at most one third of the total number of commercials
Number of commercials on Pi TV should be at least 20% of the total number of commercials
Number of commercials on Pi TV, Beta Video, and Gamma Live should be non-negative integers

NumPiTV.definition: Number of commercials aired on Pi TV

NumBetaVideo.definition: Number of commercials aired on Beta Video

NumGammaLive.definition: Number of commercials aired on Gamma Live
